faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about FitForce
faq.stillHaveQuestions: Still have questions? Chat with our team →

q1.question: How does the free trial work?
q1.answer: Start with a 7-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required. Cancel anytime.

q2.question: Can I cancel anytime?
q2.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. No long-term contracts or cancellation fees.

q3.question: How many clients can I add?
q3.answer: All plans include unlimited clients. Scale your business without worrying about additional fees.

q4.question: Is the client portal branded?
q4.answer: Yes, Team Force and Enterprise plans include custom branding options for the client portal and mobile app.

q5.question: Do you support teams?
q5.answer: Yes, our Team Force plan supports up to 3 members, and Enterprise plans support unlimited team members.

q6.question: What are your support hours?
q6.answer: We offer WhatsApp support all days of the week except Fridays from 10 AM to 7 PM. Enterprise clients get 24/7 phone support.

q7.question: Can I import my existing clients?
q7.answer: Yes, we provide easy import tools to bring in your existing client data from spreadsheets or other platforms.

q8.question: Is there a mobile app?
q8.answer: Yes, your clients get access to our mobile app (iOS & Android) where they can view plans, track progress, and communicate with you.
